liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- The performance incorporated musical quotes from Blue Morpho toward the end [1]

## The recordings

- **kglw2025-11-14.SBD** (recommended): soundboard; 0 songs; 138 min [1]

## Around the show

- Repeated electronics failures prompted Joey to request a drum solo from Cavs [1]
- Electronics crashed again, forcing the band to abandon the song entirely [1]
- Crowd chanting led Cavs back for a second solo featuring Dragon teases [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2025-11-14.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joseph Santarpia, Gaspard De Meulemeester, Grace Reader and Brandon DeLapp; source: SBD [1]
